_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja TownSquare/Rynek Miejski (149 terminow, ~27 mikroscen) - epilog gry, ostatnia lokacja odwiedzana po rozwiazaniu sprawy. Zawiera pozegnalne sceny ze wszystkimi podejrzanymi (Dirk, Moon, Symmetry+Sinthia, Wirman) oraz zartobliwe zamkniecie fabuly (nazwa 'Sybilla' dla Sally, meta-zart o czwartej scianie).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Scena SymSinthia (Symmetry+Sinthia pozegnanie) ma najwiecej niepewnosci co do przypisania konkretnych linii - oznaczona w _meta jako do weryfikacji.
_meta.uwagi: statue_early/ds2 replikuje zrodlowy blad tagow (podwojny otwierajacy [i] bez zamkniecia) dla zachowania parytetu tagow z validatorem, zgodnie z ustalona konwencja z poprzednich batchy.

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_BG/Section.en: I just meant - since, you know, it's abandoned.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_BG/Section.pl: Miałem na myśli tylko - no wiesz, jest opuszczone.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_BG/Section.en: But yeah there might be ghosts.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_BG/Section.pl: Ale tak, mogą tu być duchy.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.en: Catching up on your text messages?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.en: [i]Zero[/i] missed calls. Can you believe that? [i]Zero.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.en: Not even from Van De Peer?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.en: I'm writing him a message now. Giving him the deets.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.pl: Właśnie piszę mu wiadomość. Podaję mu szczegóły.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.speaker: Dirk

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.en: A [i]very selective[/i] version of the deets.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Dirk/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Gripps_endi.en: Oh, a nice bit of [i]breaking and entering[/i] to finish off the day?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Gripps_endi.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.en: I don't know about you, but I thought that was all [i]very[/i] interesting.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.pl: Nie wiem jak wy, ale ja uznałam to wszystko za [i]bardzo[/i] interesujące.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.en: You must be pleased, you've come away with a new story to tell around the campfire.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.pl: Musisz być zadowolona, wracasz z nową historią do opowiadania przy ognisku.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.pl: No dobra, ta rozmowa jest skończona.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.en: Uh, yeah. I would have to agree.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.en: Hm, I'm not sure it would be wise to tell too many people-
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.pl: Hm, nie jestem pewien, czy mądrze byłoby opowiadać o tym zbyt wielu ludziom-
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.en: Oh, don't worry - I'll [i]change[/i] all your names to protect your privacy.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.pl: Och, nie martw się - [i]zmienię[/i] wam wszystkim imiona, żeby chronić waszą prywatność.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.en: What are you going to change [i]my[/i] name to?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Moon/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Sally/Secti.en: I thought I was, but maybe not. Maybe this is my dream.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Sally/Secti.pl: Myślałam, że tak, ale może nie. Może to jest mój sen.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Sally/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Sally/Secti.en: That's exactly what [h]dream Grimoire[/h] would say.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Sally/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine/S.en: Maybe we should go take a look.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine/S.en: I think I can see someone standing on the deck...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine/S.pl: Chyba widzę kogoś stojącego na pokładzie...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine1/.en: That was the [i]weirdest[/i] submarine I've ever been on.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine1/.pl: To była [i]najdziwniejsza[/i] łódź podwodna, na jakiej kiedykolwiek byłem.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine1/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine2/.en: And just like that, it's gone.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine2/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine2/.en: I wonder if we'll ever see it again.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine2/.pl: Zastanawiam się, czy jeszcze ją kiedyś zobaczymy.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Submarine2/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.en: Yeah, I've got a couple friends you could stay with.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.pl: Tak, mam kilku znajomych, u których mogłybyście się zatrzymać.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.en: I'll write down the address for you.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.en: That and we've just been to tell her step-father that we're leaving Silkwirm.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.pl: To, oraz to, że właśnie powiedziałyśmy jej ojczymowi, że opuszczamy Silkwirm.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.en: We, uh - haven't worked that out yet.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.pl: My, yy - jeszcze tego nie ustaliłyśmy.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.en: ...I know a place you could go.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_SymSinthia/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.en: Easily one of the strangest days of my life.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.pl: Zdecydowanie jeden z najdziwniejszych dni w moim życiu.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.en: It's in the top five at least.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.en: What are you going to do now?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.en: So far the only thing I've decided on is to go home and have a [i]bath.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.pl: Na razie jedyne, co postanowiłem, to pójść do domu i wziąć [i]kąpiel.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.en: A bath? You haven't had enough [i]being-submerged-in-water[/i] for one day?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.pl: Kąpiel? Nie miałeś dość [i]bycia-zanurzonym-w-wodzie[/i] jak na jeden dzień?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_Wirman/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_greenlight/.en: But whatever it is, it's the source of the green light.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_greenlight/.pl: Ale cokolwiek to jest, to źródło zielonego światła.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_greenlight/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.en: That must be the logo for [i]Mr Gripp's Emporium.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.pl: To musi być logo [i]Emporium Pana Grippa.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.en: I think it's a hot air balloon.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.pl: Chyba to balon na ogrzane powietrze.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.en: I've always wanted to go in a hot air balloon!
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.en: Well then - you're in the right place!
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.pl: No to - jesteś we właściwym miejscu!
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_grippsign/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_harbor/Sect.en: It's a small harbor, with a couple of wooden jetties.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_harbor/Sect.pl: To mały port z kilkoma drewnianymi pomostami.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_harbor/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_harbor/Sect.en: This is a fishing town, right?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_harbor/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.en: There's an old lighthouse up on that rock.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.pl: Na tej skale stoi stara latarnia morska.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.en: Can we go up to the top?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.en: Do you have permission from the lighthouse keeper?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: We never got to go to the lighthouse...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: Nigdy nie udało nam się pójść do latarni...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: Well, hey. Maybe our next case'll be [i]entirely[/i] in a lighthouse.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: Cóż, hej. Może nasza następna sprawa będzie się rozgrywać [i]całkowicie[/i] w latarni morskiej.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: No way, this was [h]it[/h] - [h]this[/h] was the lighthouse case.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: Nie ma mowy, to była [h]ta[/h] - [h]to[/h] była sprawa latarni.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: I'm just saying, next time the theme will most likely be totally different.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: Mówię tylko, że następnym razem motyw najprawdopodobniej będzie zupełnie inny.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: If there even [h]is[/h] a next time.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: Would you mind not leaning on the fourth wall like that?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: Czy mogłabyś nie opierać się tak o czwartą ścianę?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: [i]Now[/i] who's leaning on the fourth wall?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: [i]Teraz[/i] to kto opiera się o czwartą ścianę?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.en: This was a [i]lot[/i] of work - it may be unsustainable.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.pl: To było [i]mnóstwo[/i] pracy - może to być niewykonalne na dłuższą metę.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_lighthouse_.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.en:
It's a signpost.
Lists a bunch of places in the town...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.pl:
To drogowskaz.
Wymienia kilka miejsc w mieście...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.en:
[i]Gripp's Emporium.
Stonetop Inn.
The Silkwirm Spectator.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.pl:
[i]Emporium Grippa.
Gospoda Stonetop.
The Silkwirm Spectator.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.en: None of those places are open, so we don't have to worry about them.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.pl: Żadne z tych miejsc nie jest otwarte, więc nie musimy się nimi martwić.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.en: Good, because I've forgotten them all already.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.pl: Dobrze, bo i tak już wszystkie zapomniałam.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_signpost/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_sky_ending/.en: How long were we on the submarine?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_sky_ending/.pl: Jak długo byliśmy na tej łodzi podwodnej?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_sky_ending/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.en: Are you surprised this didn't turn out to be about the Silversnake?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.pl: Jesteś zaskoczona, że to nie okazało się mieć związku ze Srebrnym Wężem?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.en: Although, they may be more related than we know.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.pl: Chociaż, mogą być ze sobą bardziej powiązane, niż nam się wydaje.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.en: What, the Silversnake and The Mermaid?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.en: A large stone statue on top of a fountain.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.pl: Wielki kamienny posąg na szczycie fontanny.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.en: It looks like a fisherman wrestling with some kind of... dragon?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.pl: Wygląda jak rybak zmagający się z jakimś... smokiem?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.en:
It says right here;
[i]The Silkwirm Serpent[i].
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.en: It can't be a serpent. It has legs.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.pl: To nie może być wąż. Ma nogi.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_statue_earl.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopInn.en: Five stars. Nice and quiet. Would sleep on floor again.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopInn.pl: Pięć gwiazdek. Miło i cicho. Chętnie znów prześpię się na podłodze.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopInn.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopinn.en:
[i]The Stonetop Inn.
The Best Inn in Silkwirm-on-Sea.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopinn.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.en: It's the Stonetop emblem I guess. Looks like a snowman.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.pl: To chyba godło Stonetop. Wygląda jak bałwan.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.en: It's not- why would it be a snowman???
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.pl: To nie- czemu miałby to być bałwan???
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.pl: No dobrze, to co to jest?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.en: I think it's three stones stacked on top of each other.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.pl: Myślę, że to trzy kamienie ułożone jeden na drugim.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.en: Oh that actually does make more sense.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.pl: O, to faktycznie ma więcej sensu.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_stonetopsig.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.en: It's a billboard for a theatre.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.en: Also the sign is several years old.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.pl: Poza tym ten szyld ma kilka lat.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.en: We didn't come all this way to go to the theatre.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.pl: Nie przebyliśmy tej całej drogi, żeby iść do teatru.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatre/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.en: Seems like that never actually happened...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.pl: Wygląda na to, że to nigdy się nie odbyło...
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.en: I wonder what happened to him - Wolfe?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.pl: Zastanawiam się, co się z nim stało - z Wolfe'em?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.en: ...maybe it's better that we don't know.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_theatresign.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.en: What do you think will happen to it?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.pl: Jak myślisz, co się z nim stanie?
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.en: Bulldozed. Parking lot. Within the month.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.pl: Zrównają je z ziemią. Parking. W ciągu miesiąca.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.en: I think there's a chance the people who used to live here might come back.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.pl: Myślę, że jest szansa, że ludzie, którzy tu kiedyś mieszkali, mogą wrócić.
Examine/Exam_Area_TownSquare_town/Sectio.speaker: Sally

do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.issue: Przypisanie konkretnych linii do Symmetry vs Sinthia w scenie pozegnalnej niepewne - brak metadata mowcy w zrodle (kategoria Examine bez pokrycia w speaker_map). Logika przypisania: Sinthia jako ta bardziej wycofana/przetwarzajaca ('...' w ds0/ds6/ds14), Symmetry jako ta odpowiadajaca w jej imieniu. Do potwierdzenia w grze.
